name: Round Shell Heat Exchanger
full_description: According to the official English product page, this heat exchanger is assembled from welded plates, shell, and beam flange components so that cold and hot media flow alternately inside the equipment. It is presented as keeping the high efficiency and compact structure of a plate heat exchanger while also providing the high-temperature and high-pressure resistance associated with shell-and-tube equipment for petroleum, chemical, electric power, pharmaceutical, metallurgy, refrigeration, and related industries.
advantage: Keeps the high heat transfer efficiency of plate heat exchangers.
Maintains a compact structure for process installations with limited space.
Adds higher temperature and pressure resistance associated with shell-and-tube duty.

seo_data.meta_description: Round-shell welded plate exchanger combining plate efficiency with shell-and-tube pressure resistance.
